decisions.reason: The same-message INTRODUCE already records that the bowl and spout seals must prevent liquid from seeping into the electronics, so no additional MODIFY is needed.
The bottom-seal requirement does not change the independently specified removable or flushable cleaning method.
Requiring a leak-free bowl bottom does not alter the valve mechanism, dripping constraint, or controlled flow-rate behavior.
The sealing requirement does not change the spout's bottom mounting location, barista-facing orientation, or pouring access.
The bowl-bottom sealing constraint does not change bowl depth or the enclosure-size constraint.
Leak prevention at the bowl bottom is distinct from controlling splashing during mixing and leaves the splash target unchanged.
The bottom-seal requirement does not alter vibration, shifting, base, or stabilizing-foot requirements.
The liquid-sealing decision does not change the selected 120V wall-power source.
The source adds a product sealing constraint but does not change the CAD artifact format or system-layout deliverable state.
The bottom-seal requirement has no effect on the green accent color.
The source does not change the selected side-view thickness or the constraint against an overly large enclosure.
The plumbing seal requirement does not affect the machine placard text.
